title: Deterministic GAME-01..04 replay and opt-in authoritative-history session
purpose: Verify persisted gameplay events against original domain decisions and prepare new actions from actual readback before an atomic append; never trust UI-supplied state.
scope: app/domain/gameplay-command.mjs: additive read-only snapshot validator export
app/domain/gameplay-event-replay.mjs: strict four-action deterministic event replay
tests/gameplay_replay_session.test.mjs: Node negative and replay contract cases
non_goals: No I07/I08/I10/I12 frozen evidence, status, schema, or UI mutation
No production save migration, automatic repair, merge, release or personal signoff
compatibility: Additive opt-in module; existing I08 adapter and I10 read-only shell remain unchanged. No new dependencies or database schema.
security: Replay rejects forged effects, malformed event envelopes and sequence/Lamport/request anomalies without publishing partial state. Atomic writer guards stale concurrent submissions, but legacy generic I08 append still bypasses the new gameplay path.
test_plan: I08/I10 frozen regression and prerelease matrix gate; I12 Quality fingerprint remains blocked
rollback: Revert additive branch. No user saves, frozen evidence or UI are modified.
